C.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, stated that the Finance Department completed a
budget reconciliation for 2023­2025. She also noted that the Housing Authority is running a shortfall and
is working with HUD staff to determine if reimbursements for the 2025 shortfall are possible.
